notes: Die results for poisoning and sweetening a village or bir well. The chart prints only the die bands; the CP costs and the retry limits come from 52.16 (1 CP; a failed attempt closes that well to further attempts for the Operations Stage) and 52.17 (5 CP; repeated attempts allowed, capped by the unit's CPA).
Per rulings/R-021.md, only one unit per well per Operations Stage may attempt sweetening; its CPA caps the repeated attempts.
